# Nottingham Repeaters

> Programming details for the Nottingham amateur radio repeaters GB7NR, GB3NF, and GB3NM. Keeper M0VUB. https://nottsrepeaters.org

This site replaces the public pages that were on gb7nr.co.uk and gb3nf.co.uk. The ETCC record withholds the exact site for GB3NF and GB3NM, so those locations are not published here.

## GB7NR

- Page: https://nottsrepeaters.org/gb7nr/
- 70cm DMR and D-Star, channel DVU35, on air
- Output 439.4375 MHz, input 430.4375 MHz, offset −9 MHz
- Colour code 1, DMR ID 235287
- DMR on SystemX. D-Star linked to XLX248 module P
- Hardware: MMDVM on Motorola radios, Pi-Star
- Coverage: Nottingham, locator IO92KX
- Static talkgroups: TG 235 slot 1 (235 Alive), TG 2350 slot 2 (UK ChatterBOX), TG 23590 slot 2 (East Midlands), TG 23591 slot 2 (Nottinghamshire Link). TG 23516 slot 2 (TGIF 116) is optional and only sometimes static.
- Keeper M0VUB. ETCC record 3855. ERP 14 dBW. Antenna height 10 m above ground. NoV review 13 March 2028.
- Dashboards: https://gb7nr.nottsrepeaters.org , https://dmr.freestar.network/legacy , https://xlx248.freestar.network

## GB3NF

- Page: https://nottsrepeaters.org/gb3nf/
- 2m FM, channel RV50, AllStar node 40070, on air
- Output 145.6250 MHz, input 145.0250 MHz, offset −0.6 MHz
- CTCSS 77.0 Hz, toneburst 1750 Hz, narrow deviation 2.5 kHz (12.5 kHz)
- Links only to the FreeSTAR hub, node 2196. Usually linked, and dropped when there is QRM. DTMF is switched off.
- Coverage: Nottingham and the surrounding area. Locator IO92, exact site withheld.
- Keeper M0VUB. ETCC record 4294. ERP 8.8 dBW. NoV review 20 July 2026.

## GB3NM

- Page: https://nottsrepeaters.org/gb3nm/
- Standalone 70cm FM talkthrough, channel RB07, on air
- Output 433.1750 MHz, input 434.7750 MHz, offset +1.6 MHz
- CTCSS 71.9 Hz, wide deviation 25 kHz
- Motorola DR3000. DMR on this radio is switched off. Programme the channel as 25 kHz wide.
- CTCSS drops between overs, so tone squelch hides the pips.
- Coverage: Nottingham and the surrounding area. Locator IO92, exact site withheld.
- Keeper M0VUB. ETCC record 4908. ERP 11 dBW.

## Other pages

- [About](https://nottsrepeaters.org/about/): the three stations and where the published figures come from.
- [History](https://nottsrepeaters.org/history/): how GB3NM, GB3NF, and GB7NR came to be, from 1977 to 2026.
- [Support](https://nottsrepeaters.org/support/): fault reports and coverage notes go to shane@freestar.network.
